{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A silk chiffon midi dress with a subtle floral print, A-line silhouette reaching mid-calf, color #FFD1DC (pale pink), fabric composed of 100% polyester with a flowing drape.
A structured tweed blazer cropped at the waist to allow legroom for movement, tailored fit in a classic boxy shape, color #8B4513 (saddle brown), fabric of wool blend for warmth against evening chill.
Strappy high-heeled sandals with a 3-inch heel, open-toe design, color #C0C0C0 (silver), fabric of smooth patent leather to reflect the artificial lighting.
Delicate gold drop earrings and a thin pearl choker necklace, minimalist geometric shape, color #FFD700 (gold) and #FFFDD0 (white), polished metal and cultured pearl materials.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance between elegance and practicality for a summer wedding that transitions from an outdoor ceremony to a restaurant dinner. The silk dress honors the formal social dress code while its airy fabric suits the August heat, ensuring comfort throughout the afternoon festivities. Adding the tweed blazer provides the necessary layering against the evening coolness without adding bulk or hiding the dress beneath it. Finally, the silver heels and gold accessories catch the artificial restaurant lights, drawing attention to the guest's polished look as she moves from the garden to the dining hall."}
